title: polyscias commersonii
intro: Polyscias commersonii, commonly known as the "Woolly Wolly", is a medicinal plant species native to the Pacific Islands. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of arthritis, wound healing, and protection against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Polyscias commersonii include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit analgesic and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids.
